description: Knowledge matrix for The Quiet Wife Book 1, tracking what each character knows and does not know at each milestone of the 50-chapter arc. Milestones are derived from total_chapters (50): ch1 (2%), ch10 (20%), ch25 (50%), ch36 (72%), ch50 (100%).
